default.label: Terminal
default.description: Your own Linux terminal. Files in your home folder are kept between sessions.

scratch.label: Temporary terminal
scratch.description: A throwaway terminal for one chat. Everything is deleted after 15 minutes without use.

sysbox.label: Terminal with Docker
sysbox.description: Like Terminal, but you can run Docker containers and services inside it, with more memory and CPU. Same home folder as Terminal.
